{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Alee_Aroval.png|thumb|right|200px|A [[Lannik (species)|Lannik]] and known Data Forger reprogramming an [[DT-series sentry droid|Imperial sentry droid]]]]

A '''Data Forger''' was a type of [[slicer]] with the equipment, knowledge and skill to alter permit [[Datapad/Legends|Datapads]], and forge authentic looking manifests and travel clearances. They are also able to update a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|BoSS]] records to make illegal modifications appear authorized.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>

Most Data Forgers work out of secure offices with access to their datawork tools and computer network, and successful forgers have plenty of business and hired guards to protect their assets. When discovered by authorities, forgers tend to move far away very quickly.
